title: TrimMask trimmed-shell IGA: revision data and qualified runtime
description:
Reader-focused data, current figures and plotting programs, independent scientific checks, exact input models and the qualified AutoCAD2025 CoreConsole runtime for the revised TrimMask study.

This version removes obsolete plotting implementations, author workflow and packing records, and supplies the matched-reference scientific inputs and recovery data required for verification. Reported numerical fields and runtime module bytes are preserved. Scientific negative controls and stated accuracy limits remain available.
notes: Publicly downloadable research data/runtime. All rights reserved: https://github.com/yaluji123/TrimMask-trimmed-shell-IGA/blob/main/LICENSE. No new open-source grant. Separate Clipper2, Eigen and Intel notices remain with their components.
